mentions.name: AI statement-of-work writing tool
mentions.description: This tool lets users use AI to help write statements of work while preserving the high bar for accuracy and consistency these documents require. It currently sits somewhere between Typst and Gemini in Google Docs in capability, though not as good as either yet.
mentions.problem: Using AI to write statements of work risks losing the accuracy and consistency these documents demand.
